001package pkg_entities;
002
003import java.util.Random;
004
005/**
006 * Represents a Pokemon attack with a name, base damage, and hit precision.
007 *
008 * <p>The damage returned by this class already includes the accuracy check: a missed attack returns
009 * zero damage.
010 *
011 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
012 * @version 2026.05.08
013 */
014public class Attack {
015    /** Display name of the attack. */
016    private String aName;
017
018    /** Base damage dealt when the attack hits. */
019    private int aDamage;
020
021    /** Hit precision as a percentage from 0 to 100. */
022    private int aPrecision;
023
024    /**
025     * Creates an attack with its display name, damage, and precision.
026     *
027     * @param pName the attack name
028     * @param pDamage the damage dealt on a successful hit
029     * @param pPrecision the chance to hit, expressed as a percentage
030     */
031    public Attack(final String pName, final int pDamage, final int pPrecision) {
032        this.aName = pName;
033        this.aDamage = pDamage;
034        this.aPrecision = pPrecision;
035    } // Attack()
036
037    /**
038     * Calculates the damage for one use of the attack.
039     *
040     * @return the base damage when the attack hits, or {@code 0} when it misses
041     */
042    public int getDamage() {
043        Random vRandom = new Random();
044        int vRoll = vRandom.nextInt(101);
045        int vFactor;
046
047        if (vRoll > this.aPrecision) {
048            vFactor = 0;
049        } else {
050            vFactor = 1;
051        }
052        return this.aDamage * vFactor;
053    } // getDamage()
054
055    /**
056     * Returns the attack display name.
057     *
058     * @return the attack name
059     */
060    public String getName() {
061        return this.aName;
062    } // getName()
063}
